fields.description: Olfah is a twelve-building apartment community in Sharjah, arranged around an elevated landscaped setting. Walking routes, places to play and shared leisure spaces connect the homes with the park, pools and everyday services.

overview: The September 2024 launch announced 2,787 homes across twelve buildings. Public plans reviewed here cover Buildings 1–5, not every later collection.
research.locationNote: Near the Sharjah Academy for Astronomy, Space Sciences and Technology, with access to the E311. The project microsite identifies Muweilah, Sharjah.
research.priceNote: Original Building 1 factsheet: 1BR AED 679,000; 3BR AED 1,649,000. Undated historical guides, not current inventory.
research.paymentNote: Table: original Building 1 three-bedroom reference. Its one-bedroom option states 10% down, 3% quarterly and 40% handover; full dated calendar unavailable.
research.handoverNote: Original Building 1 target: Q1 2029; not a whole-community commitment.
